title: place_check.v1
description: One decision on one of derive's review cases (no_pin, far, city_default_pin, a rejected hint-number point), in DATA decisions/place-check.jsonl. `llens place-check` writes decided_by = place-check@N by the analyst's frozen rules (plan-v2 addendum, rules_sha); a human batch adds its own rows. Never text: hint kinds, reasons, criteria, points.

reason.description: why it went to review, e.g. sources_disagree:osm_unjudged; null when decided

rules_sha.description: sha256 prefix of the rules file the decision follows

snapped_by_bias_a.description: addendum D(a): an unbiased candidate > T_osm away (hard exclusion); null = no unbiased candidate stored

locality_mismatch_b.description: addendum D(b): Google's locality != the label (recorded only)

alternative.description: auto_alternative: the index of the chosen stored candidate

criteria.description: A.1-A.6 per the addendum: c1_type, c2_number, c3_unambiguous, osm_coverage, c4_osm(_km), name_match, c5_landmark(_matches), c6_label(_km), judged_as, fail
